home.hero_body: Cases, screen protectors, chargers, cables, power banks and much more.
home.hero_lead: Accessories chosen for your exact model. Collect in Sulmona, or delivered anywhere in Italy.
home.shop_by_device_intro: Start from the phone in your hand.
home.store_title: A real shop, with real people.
home.store_body: We are a physical shop in Sulmona. If you would rather see a product before buying it, or want someone to fit the screen protector for you, come in.
home.trust_compatibility_body: Every accessory lists the models it is verified against. No guesswork.
home.trust_pickup_body: Order online, collect in Sulmona with no delivery charge.
home.trust_help_body: You are answered by the people who work in the shop, not an outsourced desk.
home.services_title: At the counter, not only online
home.service_repairs_body: Screens, batteries, connectors. We tell you first whether it is worth repairing.
home.service_fitting_body: We fit it, straight and without bubbles. Included if you buy it here.
home.service_advice_body: Bring the phone in: working out what you need beats describing it.
